reviews.author: Matthew Fuqua
reviews.text: Found a new Mechanic. Took my Nissan in with AC issues, he gave me a few options to consider and gave me his recommendation, went over the cost and I went with his recommendation. Which saved me money in the long run. Jason is an honest God fearing man and a fantastic mechanic who stands behind his work. I hope my cars run forever, but when they act up, I will be taking them to Jason's auto service.

reviews.author: ToasterKing
reviews.text: We visited Jason's shop for the first time a couple of weeks ago for service on the air conditioning in our Chevy Trax. It ended up being a much bigger job than expected, but he gave us options, did a great job, turned it around quickly, and the cost was very reasonable. It's a tiny shop but he makes up for it in effort and service. He's a really kind and patient fellow who seems to care about doing good work. I was a little hesitant when I saw bible verses all over his shop, because we've had folks who brag up front about being "honest Christian men" screw us over in the past. After this encounter, however, I believe he is what he claims to be.

reviews.author: Pamela B.
reviews.text: Mr. Jason has worked on multiple vehicles for me and my family. He has done a great job every time. He is honest, fair and reliable. Highly recommend him and his vehicle services!

reviews.author: Cannon Slawson
reviews.text: Jason’s shop is amazing. This is a small, local shop that treats people right and does great work. My experience is that it was like the Jimmy John’s of a repair shop. My sons a/c wasn’t working so I dropped the car off in the morning for Jason to take a look at it, and bam! By the afternoon we were able to pick it up with darn near snow flakes coming out of the vents. Couldn’t make a better recommendation for a local business to work with!

reviews.author: Ryan Henderson
reviews.text: There aren’t enough words to express how phenomenal Jason is. I had my car towed to his location and within the same day he had me back up and running. I was so afraid it was going to be an expensive job considering it’s a 2007 Expedition, but man was I wrong. My vehicle actually is running better than it has in a while. Jason is a very fair, honest Christian man and he does excellent work. He will always be the mechanic to work on my vehicles from here on out. Thanks again Jason, you my friend was a lifesaver.

reviews.author: Gregg Thompson
reviews.text: We are so blessed to have found Jason. He is honest and fair and has the customer’s best interest in mind. We had one vehicle getting a tune up and an exhaust issue with our other vehicle that we noticed on the way to pick up our vehicle. He gladly let us swap the vehicles and made time to address our issue within 24 hours. Thank you Jason

reviews.author: Alex Kay
reviews.text: I dropped my truck off on a Monday. Thinking it would take a few days to get to it, diagnose the issue and fix it, I was very surprised when Jason called me the next day saying he had found the issue. There were a few other issues that I asked him to look at that he fixed as well. He didn't nickel and dime me- he was more than fair with his prices. He had my vehicle finished Wednesday. Again, he was very fair, honest and had a quick turn around. I will be using him in the future for sure and also recommend him to others.

reviews.author: Anne Miller
reviews.text: These fellas really went above and beyond in a pinch. I stopped with a bolt in my tire and even though the gentleman was working on something else he took the time to get me fixed and back on the road pronto! I even made it to work almost on time. I will return with future business. Thank you!

reviews.author: Heather Knight
reviews.text: I cannot express how pleased I am with Jason's Auto Shop. He is professional, knowledgeable and I am grateful to have crossed paths with someone so honest. I am not mechanically inclined, however Jason explains things on my level. I asked him to do a safety check on my older car and had the work done over the course of a few weeks. I cannot say enough about his work and his work ethic. I always leave feeling confident in the work he has done. What a blessing. Thank you!

reviews.author: Roy Al
reviews.text: It's hard to find a good mechanic. Jason is a great honest Christian man who happens to be a great mechanic. One conversation with him and you will know you can expect fair prices and your vehicle is in good hands

reviews.author: Shervin Shoai
reviews.text: Jason is an awesome man and a professional mechanic. I took my Corvette to his shop and he simply came up with a practical solution to get my car fixed. I can say that he saved me a couple of hundred dollars at my first visit. He and his associate are the best in South Carolina.

reviews.author: Mike Ratrie
reviews.text: Jason came to the rescue when I arrived in Easley with a car that was turning off at every intersection. Despite being busy, Jason was able to diagnose and fix everything in just two days. In addition, he was pleasant and easy to do business with, along with fair pricing for the job.

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.text: My car started overheating near Jason's shop. I pulled in and he went out of his way to get me going as soon as possible. Jason was knowledgeable, honest and affordable. Thank you.

reviews.author: Ray Tarus
reviews.text: Jason took the time to look at my car the moment I walked in and fixed it at a reasonable price. I will be using him in the future. If you are in the area and have car issues go to Jasons Auto Services and he will take care of you. Ray T.

reviews.author: Teresa Cook
reviews.text: My dad always took his car and truck to jasons, and when my car needed something fixed he would always say take it to jason. He always took care of us and didn't charge us an arm and a leg. Now that my dad is gone it makes Jason's help mean even more. I thank God for his help, he is one of a kind.

reviews.author: Chris G
reviews.text: Over the years I have taken both my own and my daughters vehicles to him for various repairs. Always gives you a fair price and most importantly to me. It's done right with quality parts!

reviews.author: Stephen Lightsey
reviews.text: Excellent service. Fair and honest mechanic. That's hard to find. Keep up the great work gentlemen. Top notch!

reviews.author: Frank Boccabello
reviews.text: Jason never fails to impress me ,his work is outstanding ! He's honest and fair. Does what he says and is fast.i wish other mechanic s would be like him..great doing business with him.

reviews.author: Sandi Jaycocks
reviews.text: Jason has always been respectful and truthful in his dealings with me. He's fair on his prices and has always made sure I was satisfied with the work.

reviews.author: Cheryl P
reviews.text: Jason is awesome. I took my husbands truck up there. He was reasonably priced and very helpfull. He will be our new mechanic. Thank you.

reviews.author: tiffany Caldwell
reviews.text: This guy is a godsend. He’s professional, honest, and always polite. My only complaint is his schedule is full but that also shows I’m not the only one that thinks he’s a great mechanic. Would recommend his shop to everyone.

reviews.author: K Adams
reviews.text: My friend and I broke down in Weasley and were towed to Jason's Auto Service today around 12:30 pm. Not only was he and his technician professional but he ordered the parts, installed them and had us back on the road by 2:00 pm. GOD BLESS him and his team.

reviews.author: Heather Hall
reviews.text: Jason is an awesome mechanic. I always feel like he's being honest and wants to help me fix my car not fill his pockets! Will continue to use him for everything I can.

reviews.author: Kathy Rice
reviews.text: Highly recommend! He did an excellent job, reasonably priced, and worked with me to get the repair done quickly because I had no other vehicle to get to work.

reviews.author: Brandon Lollis
reviews.text: Great and knowledgeable mechanic excellent price and good customer service we recently had my mothers ford fusion worked on there and it was a great experience.

reviews.author: Nene M
reviews.text: Always great there. He is always patient and in good spirits. Very helpful. Would recommend him over anyone else in a 50 mile radius!!

reviews.author: patrick curlee
reviews.text: Great service, and an awesome mechanic. Very honest, and keeps his word which means alot these days. Thank you.

reviews.author: MaryAnn Giammalvo
reviews.text: He's been taking great care of our cars for years. Christian man with good heart providing great service at a reasonable price

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: Got us in quickly, knew exactly what to do, reasonable pricing! Honest and very kind! Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: Jason's Auto Service was very professional and friendly. Had the front and rear brakes repaired. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Richard Hutchison
reviews.text: Had my front brake pads and rotors replaced there. Happy with both the work and the price. Recommend.

reviews.author: Scott Brady
reviews.text: Great service. Fair pricing...and HONEST!!! You heard me right!! Finally an honest mechanic!! Will use no other for my automotive needs!

reviews.author: Michael Patterson
reviews.text: Honesty in a car mechanic, who would have thunk it. But yet this is the man who changes my perception of that personna. Good man honest prices

reviews.author: April Gibson
reviews.text: He does a great job recommended him to family and friends could ask for better service and he is a very Godly man and very honest.

reviews.author: Katie Suddeth
reviews.text: Super nice fair price did a great job getting my heat working will go back for future services thank you.

reviews.author: Brenda Brezeale
reviews.text: Thanks for the great job, professional service, reasonable prices, and family friendly atmosphere. We will use you again.

reviews.author: Danny Adams
reviews.text: Very honest and does what he says he will do when he says he will do it would recommend him any time.

reviews.author: Cora Kent
reviews.text: I was referred to him by a friend. I called him. Told him what I needed. He informed me that he didn't have the time or equipment to do what I needed. He then referred me to someone who could.

reviews.author: Lynn Sanders
reviews.text: Jason took a job that other mechanics didn’t want. He did an amazing job for a very reasonable cost. We’ve been back with other issues since then. He is friendly, fair and was really fast with the service.
